claims.text: hiQ settled LinkedIn's contract claims for $500K plus a data-destruction injunction, despite its CFAA win (Dec 2022).
LinkedIn sues Proxycurl (Nubela Pte Ltd) in January 2025; Proxycurl settled and shut down in July 2025, walking away from roughly $10 million in annual revenue.
ProAPIs sued Oct 2025, LinkedIn alleges over 1M fake accounts scraping data sold at up to $15,000/month; VP of Legal cites the Proxycurl settlement as precedent.
LinkedIn User Agreement Section 8.2 bars automated software/scripts/robots for scraping and bans bots/automation for connection requests or messages.
Starting around March 2025 LinkedIn de-listed the company pages and search visibility of Apollo.io, Seamless.ai, Evaboot, and LGM.
CNIL fined Kaspr €200,000 in December 2024 over a database of roughly 160 million contacts, citing Articles 6, 5(1)(e), and 12/14.
CAN-SPAM does not require prior consent for commercial email including B2B email; max civil penalty is $53,088 per violating email, effective Jan 17 2025.
Belkins study: 7,530,489 emails analyzed across 2025 campaigns, average reply rate 0.45%.
Optifai study: 939 companies, ~84-day median B2B SaaS sales cycle, 14-30 day SMB floor.
Origami AI is a YC F24 company co-founded by Finn Mallery and Kenson Chung, based in San Francisco.
VentureBeat reported Origami Agents' $2M seed and $50K MRR during an eight-week beta, founders calling it the fastest-growing startup in their YC batch.
Origami's Terms of Service require the customer to represent that their use of LinkedIn and any other connected platform complies with that platform's terms of service.
The viral anecdote ($25k/month, 7-hour close) has no independent corroboration anywhere online.
Clay closed a $100M Series C led by CapitalG in August 2025 at a $3.1B valuation.
TechCrunch (March 2025) found 11x.ai displayed fake customer logos (ZoomInfo, Airtable), inflated ARR, and 70-80% ex-employee-estimated churn.
Artisan AI's 'Stop Hiring Humans' billboard campaign first went viral in November-December 2024, months before its Series A closed.
Gartner survey of 227 CSOs (Aug-Sept 2025): 31% cited difficulty proving AI-tool ROI as a top 2026 challenge.
Separate Gartner survey of 645 B2B buyers: human reps 28 percentage points more likely than GenAI to be credited with advancing a deal.
Google requires SPF/DKIM/DMARC for domains sending 5,000+/day to Gmail and caps spam-complaint rate at ~0.3% (0.1% recommended).

GDPR Article 6(1)(f) allows legitimate interest as a lawful basis; Recital 47 explicitly names direct marketing as a candidate legitimate interest; Article 21 gives an absolute right to object once invoked.

California Penal Code 502(c)(2) criminalizes knowingly accessing a computer/network without permission to take, copy, or use data; Georgia O.C.G.A. 16-9-93 creates a felony 'Computer Invasion of Privacy' punishable up to $50,000 and 15 years.
Sales Navigator's Buyer Intent feature aggregates 180+ signals scoped to a saved target account interacting with the user's own company page, website, or content.
LinkedIn API Terms of Use Section 3.1, item 24 bars aggregating LinkedIn content with third-party data in ways that break user attributability.
LinkedIn's deep-learning anti-abuse system has run continuously since at least 2018, and its first production use case was specifically detecting logged-in accounts scraping profile and post data.
Instacart's continued, acknowledged scraping of Target's public prices as of a December 2025 Consumer Reports investigation.
11x.ai's CEO stepped down two months after the TechCrunch story ran.
Kennected: Dec 2022 cease-and-desist did not kill it instantly, forced a 2024 sale and rebrand, LinkedIn-automation line discontinued only in 2025.
G2 runs 'Buyer Intent Data' as a first-party product through sell.g2.com, built from its own 100M+ annual review-marketplace visitor traffic.
Mordor Intelligence: sales intelligence market ~$4.99B in 2026, from ~$4.42B in 2025, toward $9.15B by 2031 at 12.89% CAGR.
Instantly's vendor-reported average reply rate is 3.43% and 10.7%+ for 'elite' senders, sample size undisclosed.
A separate 2M+-email dataset (via Apollo/Sales.co) found a 2.09% overall reply rate, 14.1% genuinely positive (~0.64% interested-reply rate).
Apollo.io's own pages cite inconsistent contact totals: 210M in API docs, 240M+ on the flagship product page, 275M+ in the support knowledge base.
Paul Graham's 'Do Things That Don't Scale' never actually endorses legal risk-taking; the Airbnb/Craigslist connection was constructed by outside commentators, not YC itself.
Airbnb built a bot that reverse-engineered Craigslist's posting system to cross-post listings and poach hosts.
DoorDash's original MVP was a simple website with PDF menus and founders' cell numbers for orders.
Regie.ai raised a $30M Series B co-led by Scale Venture Partners and Foundation Capital in Feb 2025, total $50.8M, and brands itself around keeping humans in the loop.
Lavender's most recent round is an $11M Series A closed February 2023 (part of a $13.2M combined seed+Series A announcement), nothing newer reported through 2026.
UK ICO guidance requires a documented three-part balancing test (necessity, purpose, balancing) drawing on the CJEU's Rigas case, weighing whether the data subject would 'reasonably expect' the use.
LinkedIn told a court its technical defenses detect and restrict scraping accounts 'within about a day' (Proxycurl litigation).
